activation: Ego body clears lead body on the lead's right
controlled_variable: Lead left-turn indicator requested off versus on
raw_measurements: Observed lead VehicleLightState.LeftBlinker over the pass interval
Synchronized forward and overview frame review of indicator visibility
Observed ego and lead body pose, road and lane throughout pass

candidate_variants.fallback1: Slower requested pass if measured full-body right-pass frames equal zero
candidate_variants.fallback2: Elevated overview if fewer than 240 signal frames have reviewed pixels
candidate_variants.fallback3: Stop before pass if original Native light-state evidence is absent or observed state mismatches the request
